mapper.sql: JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(CASE M.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' ELSE '' END)
mapper.select:
SELECT M.ems_id AS emsId, L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, L.PROTCL_CD AS protclCd FROM com_ems_info M
WHERE M.use_yn='Y' AND L.USE_YN='Y' AND M.ems_id IN #{id} ORDER BY FIELD(M.ems_id,1,13,16,11,4)
mapper.sql:
SELECT C.EMS_ID AS emsId, C.DATA_SE_CD AS dataSeCd, CASE C.DATA_SE_CD WHEN 'P' THEN '성능·상태' WHEN 'C' THEN '구성' WHEN 'F' THEN '장애·상태' WHEN 'S' THEN '보안' END AS dataSeNm, L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, L.PROTCL_CD AS performanceProtocol, 'ICMP' AS pingProtocol, C.PERF_CLCT_USE_YN AS perfClctUseYn,C.PING_MNTR_USE_YN AS pingMntrUseYn, C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC AS clctCycleSec,C.STTS_MNTR_CYCLE_SEC AS sttsMntrCycleSec, C.TIMEOUT_SEC AS timeoutSec,C.RTRY_NOCS AS rtryNocs,C.TIMEOUT_POLL_SEC AS timeoutPollSec, C.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(C.EXCN_TM,'%H:%i') AS excnTm, C.CYCLE_CRTR_CN AS cycleCrtrCn, (C.STTS_MNTR_CYCLE_SEC + C.TIMEOUT_SEC*C.RTRY_NOCS) AS totalJgmtSec, CASE WHEN C.DATA_SE_CD='P' THEN U.lastDt ELSE NULL END AS lastExcnDt, NULL AS nextExcnDt, COALESCE(D.deviceCount,0) AS targetEqpmntCount FROM com_ping_info C JOIN com_ems_info M ON M.ems_id=C.EMS_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ems_id,COUNT(*) AS deviceCount FROM com_device_info WHERE use_yn='Y' GROUP BY ems_id) D ON D.ems_id=C.EMS_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ems_id,MAX(reg_dt) AS lastDt FROM raw_usage_log GROUP BY ems_id) U ON U.ems_id=C.EMS_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%H') AS hourLabel,COUNT(*) AS executionCount, 'RECEIVED' AS execSttsCd FROM ( SELECT ems_id,reg_dt FROM raw_ping_log WHERE reg_dt >= CURDATE() AND reg_dt < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT ems_id,reg_dt FROM raw_usage_log WHERE reg_dt >= CURDATE() AND reg_dt < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) R JOIN com_ems_info M ON M.ems_id=R.ems_id
WHERE R.ems_id IN #{id} AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%Y-%m-%d %H') ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), MIN(R.reg_dt)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM com_ping_info WHERE EMS_ID=#{emsId} AND DATA_SE_CD=#{dataSeCd}
